fullPassage: Suppose you have been working on the solution to a challenging technological problem for many years. Let's also suppose that you have been paying attention to whatever else you have encountered that might be related to the problem. In that case, chances are that creative solutions to the problem could suddenly pop up in your mind when you are relaxed. Such "eureka moments" (when great insights lead to discovery or invention) often take place at unexpected times. To enhance spontaneous creativity, therefore, one must pay attention to the things that could potentially lead to valuable outcomes. This does not mean that you must narrow down your interest to one specific topic. On the contrary, breadth of experience is the key to creativity. If your experience is limited to a narrow range of topics, then the scope of your imagination will likewise be narrow, which would be harmful to creativity.

❌ ① 구체적 방법: 일반 원리를 설명
❌ ③ 과학 발전 사례: 구체적 사례 없음
❌ ④ 한 분야 집중 장점: 반대(narrow = harmful)
det.tip: breadth of experience is the key to creativity

ch: 다양한 경험이 창의성에 미치는 긍정적 영향
유레카 순간이 과학 발전에 기여한 사례

questions.passage: Suppose you have been working on the solution to a challenging technological problem for many years. Let's also suppose that you have been paying attention to whatever else you have encountered that might be related to the problem. In that case, chances are that creative solutions to the problem could suddenly pop up in your mind when you are relaxed. Such "eureka moments" (when great insights lead to discovery or invention) often take place at unexpected times. To enhance spontaneous creativity, therefore, one must pay attention to the things that could potentially lead to valuable outcomes. This does not mean that you must narrow down your interest to one specific topic. On the contrary, breadth of experience is the key to creativity. If your experience is limited to a narrow range of topics, then the scope of your imagination will likewise be narrow, which would be harmful to creativity.
questions.stem: 이 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지 = 폭넓은 경험(breadth)이 창의성의 핵심이며 관심사를 좁히면 안 된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 폭넓은 경험 + 열린 태도: breadth + not narrow down ←정답
❌ ② 한 분야 몰두: 반대(breadth)
❌ ③ 편안한 상태에서만: relaxed는 조건 중 하나, 핵심 아님
❌ ④ 좁히면 전문성: harmful to creativity

ch: 창의적 해결책은 폭넓은 경험과 열린 태도에서 비롯된다.
기술 혁신은 오랜 시간 한 분야에 몰두해야 가능하다.
관심사를 좁히면 더 깊은 전문성을 얻을 수 있다.
